strategyReview: Working: WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG remains the main live edge (321/467 live wins, +0.29% avg; 188/253 shadow wins), monotonic arb is steady, USER_PM_IV_TOUCH_RICH_NO shadows are 9/10, and ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO live is 4/4 on contract P&L. Failing: the open WEEKEND funding reversion book is currently red (BABA -9.8%, MSTR -10.2%), FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG/SHORT are near scratch, PM-proxy short shadows are destructive, and single-asset weekend funding reversion variants (MU/COIN/CBRS) are not showing reliable funding normalization.

failureClusters.recommendation: Stop using PM contracts as generic proxies for spot-directional shorts unless the contract payoff is the graded target; kill shadow-proxy variants and only test explicit contract premium fades.

failureClusters.theme: Single-asset weekend funding reversion false signals
failureClusters.evidence: MU 5/14, COIN 3/9, CBRS 12/25 (48%), with loss rows often showing funding pinned at 5.5% or re-crashing to -67%/-13.4% after entry. The standalone < -10% condition enters stale/default/non-weekend readings.
failureClusters.recommendation: Refine to true weekend days plus funding in the bottom 10% of the asset's recent range, and avoid standalone < -10% thresholds.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion 9/25 (36%) and btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation 4/13 (31%); wins are dominated by two large BTC moves while most tests stall or reverse.
failureClusters.recommendation: Drop HYPE/rising-IV as continuation confirmation; instead filter out late-stage conditions such as extreme funding/overbought spot and test fade mechanics for stalled setups.

failureClusters.theme: Absolute PM-IV discount treated as timing signal
failureClusters.evidence: btc_pm_iv_expansion_reversion 3/10 (30%); PM IV below 46 against options IV above 49 frequently persists while BTC moves <2%.
failureClusters.recommendation: Invalidate the absolute-threshold timing assumption and avoid re-proposing absolute PM-IV discount variants without a distinct catalyst.

newHypotheses.description: Fade dumb-money high-YES flow: on above-strike one-touch contracts, when smart wallets are net short YES and the contract offers a positive sell-YES edge, sell the rich YES side because high-barrier flow is dumb-money chasing premium, not smart directional demand.
newHypotheses.prediction: The YES side of above-strike one-touch contracts is overpriced and the sell-YES position will be profitable over 3 days as premium decays.

newHypotheses.description: When GOLD's GLD put/call ratio is in the bottom 15% of its 7-day range while GOLD spot remains above its 24h SMA, extreme call-buying/put-selling marks an exhaustion high rather than durable upside demand. Short the spot/perp high.
newHypotheses.prediction: GOLD spot will decline more than 2% within 3 days.

newHypotheses.description: On BTC above-strike one-touch contracts, sell YES when at least one scoped contract offers a 3-8 point sell-YES edge. This is a contract premium fade, not a spot-move call: overpriced YES premium decays as the high barrier stays unchallenged.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES on BTC above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 3 days as premium decompresses.

newHypotheses.description: Sell YES on PM-IV-rich above-strike one-touch contracts when PM IV is at least 10 vol points above listed options IV and a 3-8 point sell-YES edge exists. The richness is a PM premium error, not compensation for strong spot drift.
newHypotheses.prediction: The sell-YES contract position is profitable over 3 days as rich PM IV and touch premium deflate.

newHypotheses.description: Broad one-touch premium fade: on any above-strike one-touch contract with a 3-8 point sell-YES edge, tight spread, and liquidity, sell YES. This is the broadest version of the above-strike edge family and must be graded on contract premium decay.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES on above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 3 days as excess premium decays.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: replace HYPE risk-on confirmation, which fires late after the BTC move, with a filter that BTC perp funding is not already in the top quintile of its 7-day range. This avoids chasing late-stage overextended momentum.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot gains more than 2% within 3 days when short-term trend is intact and funding is not overextended.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-170: instead of longing momentum when options IV rises, lean short when BTC is only above its 24h SMA but more than 4% below its 7d high with options IV still rising. The IV bid is hedging/distribution, not breakout confirmation.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot declines more than 2% within 3 days as elevated IV marks distribution rather than accumulation.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: require CBRS funding below -10% on true weekend days AND in the bottom 10% of its 7-day range. The original failed because standalone < -10% included stale/default 5.5 and weekday noise; this isolates genuine weekend funding stress.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS spot/perp gains more than 2% within 2 days as weekend funding stress normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-535: restrict to weekend days and extreme current funding vs its own 7-day range, not just below -10%. The original fired on stale 5.5 readings and weekday noise; this isolates true weekend funding dislocations.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU spot/perp gains more than 2% within 2 days as weekend funding stress broadly reverts.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-538: require COIN funding below -20% on true weekend days and in the bottom 10% of its 7-day range. The original's < -10% threshold captured default 5.5 and non-weekend readings that never normalized.
newHypotheses.prediction: COIN spot/perp gains more than 2% within 2 days as weekend funding stress normalizes.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-108's family is 36% over scorable tests, with wins only in two violent BTC breaks (+9.66%, +22.67%). HYPE risk-on did not discriminate; losses occurred with BTC -3.47%, +0.70%, and flat near the 7d high.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than a late-stage risk-on echo.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS funding < -10% produced 12/25 but several losses show no normalization: 5.5% → -67.0%, 2.3% → -13.4%, 5.5% → 5.5%. The condition is firing on stale/default/non-weekend readings where funding stays pinned or re-crashes.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days and forces spot higher.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU funding < -10% produced 5/14, with many entries at 5.5% that never reverted: 5.5 → -10.3, 5.5 → 5.5, 5.5 → 4.4. The threshold is not isolating true extreme stress and often catches a default 5.5% reading.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Extreme negative MU funding (< -10%) outside true weekend hours reliably normalizes and yields >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Family is 4/13. The long prediction is contradicted by several test rows graded as spot_directional_short that lost on BTC +3.31%; remaining long observations show choppy 0.04%-0.75% moves that do not clear +2%. Rising option IV during spot strength is hedging/call-chasing, not continuation confirmation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Spot momentum confirmed by rising options IV reliably leads to further >2% BTC gains within 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Only 3/10 passed. The two wins came from large down moves, while eight entries produced absolute moves <2%. PM IV below 46 vs options IV above 49 is a persistent structural discount, not a short-horizon timing condition; it can stay pinned while BTC drifts.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: PM IV underpricing options IV by >8% reliably leads to a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: COIN funding < -10% produced 3/9; failures include 5.5 → 5.5, 29.1 → 20.6, and 9.7 → 5.5. The condition frequently enters when funding has already normalized or is decaying from positive levels, so there is no funding stress to unwind.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: COIN funding below -10% reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's review strengthens the case that the only robust live edges are weekend HL funding reversion, monotonic arb, and contract-level rich-NO/touch fades. PM-proxy short shadows continue to fail because they grade contract P&L on spot-directional theses. Single-asset weekend funding reversion variants need true weekend and relative funding extremity filters, not standalone -10% thresholds. The BTC momentum/IV confirmation families are late or mis-graded and should be refined toward either funding-conditioned continuation or stalled-momentum fade. I lowered FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG stop to 1.5% because 12/39 trades stopped and average live P&L is negative; tighter risk should reduce bleed before this family earns more tests.
